title: Harvest and Smile
author: Dominic Eastwick
blurb: Cyrus Crane, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
